scope: Targeted discovery and metadata/README review. All 23 reviewed resources remain pending-editorial-review in the discovery queue. No catalog promotions, category publication, runtime tests, security audits or commercial-license clearance.
method: Three bounded native Codex subagent tasks: two GPT-6 Luna and one GPT-6.1 Sol. Codex lead rechecked canonical IDs and live repository metadata for all 23 records, compared all candidate IDs against the full 1,307-entry catalog and 1,879-candidate queue at base_commit, reviewed summaries, and preserved original discovery provenance. Seventeen new candidates were confirmed through exact repo: repository searches. The 70 original broad-topic searches were not rerun.
